teaser: The smell of coffee going cold on a desk nobody has cleared yet. You are a 6, and you are an ENTJ, and the crossing shows up first as someone doing two jobs at once: tending the people in the room and running the room itself. The 6 wants everyone fed, settled, accounted for. The ENTJ wants the plan executed and the outcome secured. In you those aren't rivals so much as a single habit worn two ways, care dressed as command and command dressed as care, each one standing in for the other when the day gets long.
excerpt: Plans get made before the relationship is a year old — a timeline, a sense of where this is heading, who moves in and when.
